name: Omari
author: bergdahlchi
description: Toggle Omari mode: niri-like scrollable tiling for Omarchy (scrolling layout, 3-finger swipe, column-aware focus, SUPER+PageDown/PageUp workspace switching) plus a niri-style overview on a stageless 4-finger swipe -- up to zoom out into it, down to zoom into what you are looking at.

barWidget.description: Toggle Omari mode: niri-like scrolling layout, 3-finger swipe, column-aware focus (SUPER+arrows), workspace switching (SUPER+PageDown/PageUp), and a 4-finger-swipe overview.
